theater: 也門薩那盆地與哈拉茲山

battle.name: 薩珊王朝重新征服也門
battle.theater: 也門薩那盆地與哈拉茲山
battle.brief: 五七五年，薩珊波斯將領瓦赫里茲率八千人再度進入也門，攻破埃塞俄比亞（阿克蘇姆）扶植的王位、結束其統治。戰役圍繞薩那盆地與哈拉茲山展開：波斯軍海陸並進，圍城奪路，切斷紅海航線。卡面的秦連弩在本役的位置，是阿拉伯傳說中教希米亞人射「方」的那件中國弩。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是薩珊帝國與阿克蘇姆王國（埃塞俄比亞）一方在也門的角力。波斯方面由國王庫思老一世（531至579年在位）直接授權，將領瓦赫里茲率波斯主力軍入也門；薩珊的指揮系統是沙赫直屬的禁衛與重裝部隊、附庸軍與行省軍三者合流，也門附庸王沙伊夫（Maʿd-Karib之子）代表本地政權與波斯王室的雙重權力，攻城所需的工匠隊與小型艦隊則由西拉夫港及美索不達米亞調撥。阿克蘇姆一方是紅海兩岸的王國體制：國王居阿克蘇姆，戰爭則由其海軍與遠征軍團在紅海西岸的港口（阿杜利斯一帶）集結，軍隊包含阿克蘇姆步兵、弓箭手與象隊，另有被扶植的也門王族殘部作為內應，埃塞俄比亞高原的貴族與沿海商人網絡負責補給。阿克蘇姆的基督教國家體制與波斯以瑣羅亞斯德教立國的體制互不相容，兩國在紅海航線與香料貿易上又直接競爭。拜占庭皇帝在旁觀：既要阻止波斯取得紅海東岸，又不敢開罪阿克蘇姆的基督徒同胞，這種外交張力正是本役的背景。
countriesEn: This war was fought between the Sasanian Empire and a coalition of the Aksumite kingdom of Ethiopia and the Himyarite factions of Yemen that the Aksumites had been backing. On the Persian side the orders came directly from the shahanshah Khosrow I (reigned 531 to 579), who dispatched the main body of the Sasanian army under the general Vahrez. Sasanian command combined three elements: the shah's own guard and heavy troops, the contingents of client states, and the provincial levies of the empire. The client king of Yemen, Saif (son of Maʿd-Karib), embodied the dual authority of the local dynasty and the Persian crown, while the siege engineers and the small squadron of warships needed for the operation were drawn from Siraf on the Persian Gulf and from Mesopotamia. The Aksumite side worked on the Red Sea model: the king ruled from Aksum proper, but for this war the troops mustered at the ports of the western shore, around Adulis, and the expedition was composed of Aksumite infantry, archers and elephant units, reinforced by the surviving Yemeni royal house that acted as an internal sponsor. The noble houses of the Ethiopian plateau and the merchant networks of the coast provided the supply system. An Aksumite state that was Christian at the top stood against a Sasanian state organised around Zoroastrian kingship, and the two competed directly for the shipping lanes and the incense trade. The Byzantine emperors watched from the side: they wanted to deny Persia the eastern shore of the Red Sea without alienating the Christian coreligionists of Aksum, and that diplomatic tension is the background of this campaign.
people: 核心人物是薩珊國王庫思老一世與將領瓦赫里茲（Vahrez，中文史料亦作瓦赫里茲，阿拉伯與敘利亞語記載中同名）。庫思老一世在575年重啟戰爭，是因為也門附庸王沙伊夫被阿克蘇姆人殺死，薩珊在阿拉伯半島最遠的據點面臨淪陷；他派出的瓦赫里茲既是戰場指揮，也是後來被記為也門世襲總督的人物。對面的阿克蘇姆王位繼承者與其將領姓名大多失傳，只知570年攻入也門的卡貝爾與其後裔留下了阿布拉哈一系的名號；被殺的馬斯魯克·阿布拉哈與後來遇害的沙伊夫，是兩次波阿衝突的轉折點。拜占庭皇帝查士丁二世與其謀臣試圖用外交與使節拆散波斯—阿克蘇姆的聯盟。記載此事的阿拉伯史家塔巴里與伊本·希沙姆又保存了兩名中國俘虜（al-Nasib與al-Muhallab）的故事：他們被阿克蘇姆人帶到也門，傳授希米亞人使用中國的連弩。這段傳說是本役唯一把中國兵器直接拉進南阿拉伯戰場的記載，學界多視為文學加工，真實性無法證實，但仍值得記下，因為它正對應卡面那件秦連弩。
peopleEn: The central figures are the Sasanian king Khosrow I and the commander Vahrez, called by that name in the Arab and Syriac sources. Khosrow I reopened the war in 575 because Saif, the client king of Yemen, had been killed by Aksumites, and the most exposed of the Sasanian footholds in Arabia was about to be lost; the man he sent, Vahrez, was both the battlefield commander and the figure remembered afterwards as the hereditary governor of Yemen. On the Aksumite side the name of the reigning king and of his generals is largely lost: we know only of Kaleb, who had invaded Yemen in 570, and of the line of Abraha that descended from him. Masruq Abraha, who fell in the first round, and Saif, who was killed later, are the two hinge points of the whole affair. The Byzantine emperor Justin II and his advisers tried to break the Persian and Aksumite alliance with envoys and diplomacy. The Arab historians al-Tabari and Ibn Hisham preserved the story of two Chinese prisoners, al-Nasib and al-Muhallab, who were carried to Yemen by the Aksumites and taught the Himyarites to shoot the fanj, the Chinese repeating crossbow. That tale is the only record that brings a Chinese weapon directly onto a battlefield in southern Arabia. Scholars generally treat it as literary embellishment and it cannot be verified, yet it deserves to be set down, because it is exactly the weapon shown on this card.
kits: 卡面兵器秦連弩在本役的位置要分兩層講。就薩珊與阿克蘇姆的實際軍械而言，雙方主幹是弓：波斯是環帶與複合結構的角弓，騎兵用弓，步兵用劍、斧與標槍；阿克蘇姆步兵以長矛密集列陣，弓手以箭雨支援，象則用來撕開陣線。攻城一方有雲梯、撞桿、攻城塔，以及被印度與波斯文獻稱為犀牛的攻城撞具，投石機亦見於記載。海上則是從波斯灣西拉夫出發的小型戰船與阿拉伯海帆船，加上阿克蘇姆自阿杜利斯與紅海西岸港口派出的船隊，雙方爭奪的是曼德海峽與紅海北段的航路。秦連弩之所以會出現在本役的敘述裡，是因為阿拉伯傳說中的方（fanj）指的就是中國式連弩：由弩機蓄力、一踏一發、可連射的中國弩，兩名中國俘虜被說成以此教會希米亞人射擊；傳說中連弩先在阿克蘇姆一方發揮作用，後來波斯軍也學會並用於攻勢。作為實物參照，漢代弩兵已有布二十萬弩一類集中齊射的記載，秦弩的機關原理在漢代文獻中已見定型，後世所謂諸葛弩已是唐宋以後的說法。至於575年是否真有中國工匠在也門教弩，只有上述傳說一個來源，並無考古或第二份文獻可以佐證。
kitsEn: The card weapon, the Chinese repeating crossbow, has to be placed at two different levels. As far as the actual armament of the Sasanians and the Aksumites is concerned, the backbone on both sides was the bow: the Persians used composite recurve bows of horn and sinew, with cavalry armed with bows and infantry with swords, axes and spears; the Aksumite infantry fought in dense ranks of spears, supported by volleys of arrows, while the elephant was used to open the line. The besiegers brought scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and the siege engine that Indian and Persian texts call a rhinoceros, with stone-throwers also mentioned. At sea there were the small warships that sailed from Siraf and the Arab dhows, plus the Aksumite fleets out of Adulis and the other western shore ports, and what the two sides fought over was the Bab al-Mandab and the northern reaches of the Red Sea. The repeating crossbow appears in the account of this war only because the fanj of the Arab storytellers was the Chinese repeating crossbow: a weapon whose stock stores the tension of the bow and is released treadle by treadle, so that it can shoot in succession. The two Chinese prisoners are said to have taught the Himyarites to use it, and in the story the repeating crossbow first served the Aksumite side, while the Persians afterwards learned it and used it in their own attack. As a check on the real object, the crossbow troops of the Han already massed their fire in the manner recorded as deploying two hundred thousand bolts, and the mechanism of the Qin crossbow was already fixed in Han texts, while what is called the Zhuge crossbow is a later standardisation of the Tang and Song onwards. Whether Chinese craftsmen actually taught the weapon in Yemen in 575 has only this one source, and neither archaeology nor a second text supports it.
tactics: 波斯軍在也門的戰術主軸是海陸兩路夾擊與攻城技術。從西拉夫出發的船隊沿波斯灣、阿拉伯海岸繞行，經曼德海峽進入紅海；陸上主力則沿美索不達米亞南下，取道奈季蘭一線的商路與牧道，穿越阿拉伯沙漠進入也門北部高原，再依賴也門附庸提供的嚮導與糧食。兵鋒指向薩那：這座建於高地上、以哈拉茲山為屏障的王都控扼提哈馬沿海平原與內陸高原的通道，居高臨下，攻城方必須仰攻。圍城時波斯人以撞桿與攻城塔對付山牆，以封鎖水源、斷絕城郊的耕地與引水渠來孤立守軍，同時分兵佔領提哈馬海岸與通往沙卜瓦（希米亞舊都、哈德拉毛的香脂集散地）的商道，把對方的收入與補給一併掐斷。阿克蘇姆一方的戰術則是把軍隊集中在薩那與其他山城死守，並在野戰中倚賴象兵與弩手；阿拉伯傳說還描述希米亞人以成排的連弩齊射壓制波斯前鋒，直到波斯人自己也掌握這種武器，攻守才互換。
tacticsEn: The Persian plan in Yemen turned on a two-pronged advance by land and sea and on siegecraft. The squadron out of Siraf ran around the coast of the Arabian peninsula and entered the Red Sea through the Bab al-Mandab, while the land column moved south from Mesopotamia along the caravan and grazing tracks that lead to Najran, crossed the Arabian desert and climbed into the northern highlands of Yemen, depending on the guides and grain supplied by the Yemeni clients. The point of the advance was Sana'a: a royal capital set on high ground and screened by the Haraz mountains, commanding the passage between the Tihama coastal plain and the interior plateau, so that an attacking force had to take it uphill. During the siege the Persians worked the walls with rams and siege towers, cut the water supply and isolated the cultivated plots and irrigation channels outside the town, and at the same time detached troops to seize the Tihama coast and the road to Shabwa, the old Himyarite capital and the entrepot of the Hadramaut incense, so as to close the other side's income and supply together. The Aksumite tactic was to concentrate inside Sana'a and the other mountain fortresses and to fight the open battle with elephants and crossbowmen. The Arab tradition adds that the Himyarites answered the Persian advance with ranks of repeating crossbows firing in unison, until the Persians had learned the same weapon and the initiative changed hands.
data: 可核的數字不多，但有幾個夠用。薩珊方面有一條明確記載：575年瓦赫里茲率領的波斯軍為八千人，這是二次文獻中對本次遠征兵力的唯一具體數字；阿克蘇姆一方的兵力、陣亡與攻城損失則完全不見記載，只能說其遠征軍曾是一支以象隊與海軍為核心的混合部隊，不宜代為推算。戰役的時序可以排出來：570年前後波斯第一次介入也門，圍攻薩那，馬斯魯克陣亡；其後沙伊夫登上王位，與阿克蘇姆相安數年；575年沙伊夫被殺，戰爭重啟，瓦赫里茲再入也門，最終結束阿克蘇姆的統治，其後雙方衝突延續到578年前後，總跨度約八至十年；575年那一役的確切月份史無定論，一般繫於秋冬役期。地理上，薩那距紅海提哈馬海岸約一百五十至二百公里，薩那至奈季蘭約四百公里，波斯本土至也門的陸路行程逾一千公里，必須靠海運補給才能維持。雙方的具體傷亡數字一律查不到，本篇不作估算。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are few, but a few are usable. There is one explicit number for the Persian side: the force Vahrez led into Yemen in 575 numbered eight thousand men, the only concrete figure preserved for this expedition in the secondary literature. The strength of the Aksumite army, its losses in the field and its losses before the walls are simply not recorded; all that can be said is that the expedition was a mixed force built around elephants and a fleet, and no substitute figure should be invented for it. The sequence can be laid out: about 570 Persia intervened in Yemen for the first time, besieged Sana'a, and Masruq fell; Saif then took the throne and the two sides lived beside one another for several years; in 575 Saif was killed, the war resumed, Vahrez entered Yemen again and in the end ended the Aksumite rule, with the conflict trailing on towards 578, a total span of roughly eight to ten years. The exact month of the campaign of 575 is not established and is generally tied to an autumn or winter campaigning season. Geographically Sana'a lies some one hundred and fifty to two hundred kilometres from the Tihama coast on the Red Sea and about four hundred kilometres from Najran, while the land road from Persia to Yemen runs beyond a thousand kilometres and can only be sustained by seaborne supply. No casualty figure survives on either side, and none is estimated here.
cause: 直接起因是也門王位繼承的崩潰與主權之爭。570年前後，阿克蘇姆在卡貝爾王時代就已渡紅海攻入也門，殺害當地基督徒與阿克蘇姆所支持的王室；也門掌權者馬ʿ德-卡里卜（阿拉伯史料作優素福·杜·努瓦斯）走投無路，向薩珊求助，於是也門的內政變成兩大帝國的角力。庫思老一世支持也門附庸政權，本意是換取香料航路與紅海東岸的基地，把阿克蘇姆的影響擋在曼德海峽之外；阿克蘇姆則必須取回也門，才能保住紅海的貿易與教會聯繫，於是再起兵端。575年的導火線是附庸王沙伊夫被阿克蘇姆人殺死，薩珊在阿拉伯半島最脆弱的一枚棋子就此失守，波斯才不得不再次用兵。更深層的起因是香料與航路之爭：也門的沒藥與乳香是當時地中海與波斯世界的高價商品，誰控制提哈馬的港口與商道，誰就控制紅海與印度洋之間的轉口利潤，這場戰爭本質上是兩國對同一條商路的一次下注。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the collapse of a succession and a struggle over sovereignty. Around 570, in the time of King Kaleb, Aksum had already crossed the Red Sea into Yemen and killed Christians there together with the royal house it had backed; the man then holding power in Yemen, Maʿd-Karib, called Yusuf Dhu Nuwas in the Arab sources, had nowhere to turn and asked the Sasanians for help, and the internal quarrel of Yemen became a trial of strength between two empires. Khosrow I backed the client regime in Yemen because he wanted the incense routes and a base on the eastern shore of the Red Sea, so as to hold the Aksumites off on their side of the Bab al-Mandab. Aksum, for its part, had to recover Yemen to keep the trade and the church links of the Red Sea alive, and so it took up arms again. The spark of 575 was the killing of the client king Saif by Aksumites: the most fragile piece the Sasanians held on the Arabian peninsula was lost, and the shah had to use his army once more. The deeper cause is the quarrel over spices and routes. Myrrh and frankincense from Yemen were among the most valuable goods of the Mediterranean and the Iranian world, and whoever held the ports and caravan roads of the Tihama held the customs revenue of the passage between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. This war was in its essence two states staking everything on the same commercial road.
impact: 戰後也門成為薩珊帝國版圖最遠的海外屬地，薩珊的邊界從美索不達米亞一直推到紅海東岸與印度洋的門戶，這條延伸線在此後數十年裡是薩珊海權與商路的骨架，也門的港口與香脂產區自此長期納入波斯稅網。宗教格局被改寫：也門的基督徒社群在波斯統治下獲得寬容，奈季蘭等地的教會得以延續，而阿克蘇姆在紅海東岸的傳教與保護網被切斷；阿克蘇姆王國的國力被遠征開支與貿易收入流失拖垮，學者稱此役是阿克蘇姆的黃昏，之後它一蹶不振。也門的兵員則被編入波斯帝國的軍隊，遠征美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞戰線，與拜占庭的長期消耗戰因此多了一支生力軍。整體而言，波斯在阿拉伯半島取得了戰術勝利，卻背上了一個長期駐軍的財政與治理包袱；628年波斯在也門的將領馬茲達克反叛，殺死波斯總督，駐軍隨即撤回，此後阿克蘇姆一度復辟，直到七世紀中葉哈里發國家的軍隊接管南阿拉伯，薩珊在也門的半個世紀才真正收場。
impactEn: After the campaign Yemen became the most distant overseas possession of the Sasanian Empire, and the Sasanian frontier ran from Mesopotamia all the way to the eastern shore of the Red Sea and the gateway of the Indian Ocean. That extended line became the skeleton of Sasanian sea power and commerce for the decades that followed, and the ports and incense lands of Yemen entered the Persian fiscal system for good. The religious map was redrawn: the Christian communities of Yemen were tolerated under Persian rule, the churches of Najran and elsewhere survived, and the Aksumite mission and protective network on the eastern shore of the Red Sea were cut off. Aksum was worn down by the cost of the expedition and the loss of trade income, and historians call this war the swan song of Aksum, after which it declined steadily. Yemenite troops were incorporated into the imperial army and sent to the Mesopotamian and Armenian fronts, adding fresh manpower to the long war of exhaustion against Byzantium. In sum Persia won a tactical victory on the peninsula but inherited a garrison it could not afford for long. In 628 the Sasanian commander in Yemen, Mazdak, rebelled and killed the Persian governor, the garrison was withdrawn, Aksumite rule returned for a time, and the Sasanian half century in Yemen was finally closed when the armies of the caliphate took southern Arabia over in the years after 634.
result: 結果是阿克蘇姆在也門的統治結束，也門重歸薩珊保護。575年瓦赫里茲率八千波斯軍平定全境，被後世記為也門的世襲總督，附庸王位則由波斯另行安排的人選續用；埃塞俄比亞的象隊與艦隊退回紅海西岸，紅海東岸的商道與港口轉入波斯—也門體系的控制。此役之後，波斯與阿克蘇姆的衝突仍有零星餘波，至578年前後才逐漸平息。薩珊對也門的實際統治維持到628年馬茲達克之亂與波斯撤軍才告終；其後阿克蘇姆一度重佔也門，並在伊斯蘭興起後仍維持既有格局，最終由哈里發軍隊在634年後的數年內完成南阿拉伯的接管，薩珊帝國在阿拉伯半島最後的立足點連同其南海航線一起消失，落到新生的阿拉伯帝國手中。就兵器史而言，這場戰役同時留下兩筆帳：秦式連弩在阿拉伯史書中以教弩的俘虜形象被記錄下來，而在軍務層面真正決定勝負的，仍是能跨海運兵、能封鎖航路、能圍城拔寨的波斯國家機器。
resultEn: The result was the end of Aksumite rule in Yemen and the return of the country to Sasanian protection. In 575 Vahrez brought eight thousand Persians to subdue the whole country, was remembered as the hereditary governor of Yemen, and the client throne was continued with men appointed by Persia. The Aksumite elephants and fleets withdrew to the western shore of the Red Sea, and the lanes and ports of the eastern shore passed under the control of the Persian and Yemenite system. Some further clashes between Persia and Aksum followed this campaign, dying down towards 578. Sasanian control in fact lasted until the revolt of Mazdak and the withdrawal of the garrison in 628. Aksum then occupied Yemen again for a while and kept its own arrangements after the rise of Islam, and the final handover came with the armies of the caliphate in the years after 634, when the last Sasanian foothold on the Arabian peninsula, together with its southern maritime lines, disappeared into the hands of the new Arab state. As far as the history of arms is concerned, this war leaves two accounts: the Chinese repeating crossbow entered the Arab historical tradition in the shape of the prisoners who taught the bow, while at the level of operations the thing that actually decided the contest was the Persian state machine, which could move an army across the sea, close a shipping lane and take a walled city.
